News Summary
▪ Fourth-quarter revenue was $13.7 billion, down 4% year-over-year (YoY). Full-year revenue was $52.9 billion,

▪ Forecasting first-quarter 2026 revenue of $11.7 billion to $12.7 billion; expecting first-quarter EPS attributable to
Intel of $(0.21) and non-GAAP EPS attributable to Intel of $0.00.

financial results.

demand. Our priorities are clear: sharpen execution, reinvigorate engineering excellence, and fully capitalize on the
vast opportunity AI presents across all of our businesses.”

500184d0-d701-4e78-aa5e-53c663e99fc0.content: Intel faces severe financial stress: negative earnings, thin operating margins, negative free cash flow, and a debt load exceeding liquid assets by ~$51B, while Fitch has downgraded its IDR to BBB with a negative outlook. Key risks include persistent foundry operating losses, AI market share erosion, and U.S. export controls on China. Actionable next steps are to monitor quarterly foundry margin progress, cash flow and debt repayment milestones, and any updates on export license impacts. A gap is the lack of segment-level profitability detail in the summaries, so request the 10-Q’s foundry and Mobileye segment disclosures to model turnaround viability.
